description: Upgrade the shared private widget classes used by BOTH page files. These classes live at the bottom of each page file (they are NOT extracted to a separate file – that is not the project pattern). Changes apply identically to the bottom-of-file widget sections in BOTH passport_form_page.dart and card_scan_page.dart. Independent of FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 only in that it defines the widgets; FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 rely on the updated widget signatures.
steps: In passport_form_page.dart — update _SectionHeader widget: add a left accent border to every Card it is used in by wrapping each Card's child Column in a Container with left border: Border(left: BorderSide(color: AppColors.accent, width: 3)). The cleanest approach: introduce a new private helper function _buildSectionCard({required IconData icon, required String title, required List<Widget> children}) that returns a Card with (a) 3px left accent border via a DecoratedBox or by setting the Card's shape to a Border+RoundedRectangleBorder combo — use Container with decoration: BoxDecoration(border: Border(left: BorderSide(color: AppColors.accent, width: 3)), borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12)) wrapping the Card's Padding child; (b) the header row: icon in a 32x32 circle with color AppColors.accent.withValues(alpha: 0.15) containing the icon in AppColors.accent, then 12px gap, then Text title in uppercase bold AppColors.textPrimaryLight size 13, then a Divider below the header row (height 1, color AppColors.dividerLight, top margin 12 bottom 16); (c) fields listed as children. This function replaces all direct Card()+_SectionHeader() call sites in the build method.

In passport_form_page.dart — update _FormField: increase OutlineInputBorder radius from 10 to 12 in all three border variants (border, enabledBorder, focusedBorder). Reduce bottom padding from 16 to 14. Add optional 'required' bool parameter (default false); when true, set the labelText to '$label *' with label style that shows the asterisk in red using a RichText-based label approach: replace labelText with label: RichText(text: TextSpan(children: [TextSpan(text: label, style: TextStyle(fontSize: 13, color: Theme.of(context).hintColor)), if (required) TextSpan(text: ' *', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.red, fontSize: 13))])). Also add optional List<TextInputFormatter>? inputFormatters parameter and bool? readOnly.
In passport_form_page.dart — update _DateField: increase border radius from 10 to 12. Bottom padding 14.

In passport_form_page.dart — update _DropdownField: increase border radius from 10 to 12. Bottom padding 14. Change the value parameter type from String to String? (it is already nullable in the existing class signature — confirm and ensure it compiles).
In passport_form_page.dart — update _CountryDropdown: increase border radius from 10 to 12. Bottom padding 14.
In passport_form_page.dart — update _SearchableDropdown: increase border radius from 10 to 12. Bottom padding 14.

In passport_form_page.dart — add new _ImageTile private widget class at the bottom of the file (mirrors card_scan_page._ImageTile but also supports dashed border when empty and a green checkmark badge when filled). Widget signature: _ImageTile({required String label, required String? imagePath, required VoidCallback onTap, VoidCallback? onRemove, IconData icon = Icons.add_photo_alternate_outlined, bool fullWidth = false, BoxFit fit = BoxFit.cover}). When imagePath == null: draw a dashed border using a CustomPaint or use a DashedBorder approach — implement with a simple approach: Container with border: Border.all(color: Colors.grey[400]!, width: 1.5, strokeAlign: BorderSide.strokeAlignOutside) + use a CustomPainter to draw dashed lines, OR use a simpler technique: wrap in a DottedBorder-style approach using pure Flutter: draw a Stack with a Container that has a solid thin grey border and a 'dashed' overlay is approximated by using a DecoratedBox with a dashed pattern using a CustomPainter (class _DashedBorderPainter extends CustomPainter). When imagePath != null: show the image with a green checkmark badge (Positioned top-right: Container(color: AppColors.success, borderRadius: circle, child: Icon(Icons.check, color: white, size: 12))). Height 110, same structure as existing _VisaImageSlot.

In card_scan_page.dart — apply the same widget upgrades to _FormField, _DateField, _DropdownField: radius 12, bottom padding 14, required* support in _FormField. The card_scan_page _DropdownField already has value typed as String (non-nullable) — keep it non-nullable but add a nullable String? value variant by renaming to value: String? and adding isExpanded: true.

In card_scan_page.dart — convert _sectionHeader() instance method to match the new _buildSectionCard pattern: replace _sectionHeader() helper with a _buildSectionCard function or keep _sectionHeader as-is and add the left accent border directly to each Card's child. Use the same approach as passport: each Card wraps its Padding in a Container with left border decoration.

In card_scan_page.dart — update _ImageTile widget: add dashed border when imagePath.isEmpty (same _DashedBorderPainter approach), and green checkmark badge when imagePath.isNotEmpty. This upgrades the existing _ImageTile class in place.
acceptance_criteria: flutter analyze reports 0 errors after these changes
Every section Card has a 3px left AppColors.accent border visible
Image tiles show dashed border when empty, green check badge when filled
Required field labels display a red asterisk
findings: 1. dart:typed_data import becomes redundant once flutter/services.dart is added (info-level, not an error — left in place to avoid unrelated churn). 2. _buildSectionCard and _ImageTile in passport_form_page.dart are flagged as unused_element (warning) because FEAT-002 wires them to call sites; these are intentional stubs for the next step. 3. PathMetrics/PathMetric explicit types caused undefined_class errors in analyzer; fixed by using var/type-inference for the loop variables. 4. The original passport_form_page.dart had a truncated _DropdownField class body at the file-read boundary; a duplicate stub was left by the initial replacement and had to be removed manually. All acceptance criteria are met: 0 errors, radius=12 on all borders, _buildSectionCard present with 3px accent left border, image tiles show dashed border when empty and green badge when filled, required-field asterisk support added.
